skill_name: Explain the properties of a semiconductor.
workflow: A semiconductor is a material that has properties between a conductor and an insulator. This means that they allow some electrical current to flow under certain conditions and block electric current at other times. They are also known as a type of resistive material because electric current can only flow through them if a small force is applied.
